In this '''mission''', a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] operatives was dispatched from [[Dankayo Base]] to destroy the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Armored Transport|Armored Transport]] [[Elusive (transport)|''Elusive'']], which had captured sensitive data about Rebel activities in the [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] under Dankayo Base's command.
